findings.evidence: Patch lines 10-19 add `"partiallySupersededReservations": [ {path, recipientSession, recipientLease, frozenSource, authority, limitation} ]` to OWNER-W2-PR85-INTEGRATION. scripts/acceptance/verify-release-manifest.ts@3df14c2:257-264 sets OWNERSHIP_RULE_KEYS = {id, owner, lane, mode, state, patterns}; exactKeys (275-277) at 385-405 returns TRUSTED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID ('Every ownership rule must match the canonical rule structure'). verify-production-state.ts:251-259 maps that to CURRENT_OWNERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_INVALID, and it is consumed at line 866 (npm verify:production-state).
